$comment: The source of sf-input-image's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/image-field (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs from simai/ui-source@5100227 src/smart/image-field/smart.manifest.json); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Its x-todo are decided in x-decisions.

name.summary: The form name the chosen file is submitted under, by the platform file input inside.

label.summary: The field label above the image; it names the group. Without it the group is named «Изображение» / Image.

hint.summary: Help text under the field; slot `hint` takes markup instead.

accept.summary: What the file dialog offers and a drop accepts: `.ext`, `type/*` or `type/sub`, comma separated.

max-size.summary: The largest file in bytes; 0 for none. A larger file is not taken and is said under the field (reason size) -- the name sf-file-upload has.

min-width.summary: The narrowest picture in pixels; 0 for none. The picture is read before it is taken, and a narrower one is said under the field (reason min-width).

min-height.summary: The lowest picture in pixels; 0 for none (reason min-height).

size.summary: Field size: 1/2, 1 or 2, as every form field.

layout.summary: How the field stands (C94 point 1). row: the thumbnail, the name and size and the buttons on one row, for forms, settings and narrow panels. preview: the picture in its frame and that row under it, as wide as the picture (with a floor for a name and the buttons), for a cover, an avatar, a logo or a product photo. The buttons are never laid over the picture (point 2).

shape.summary: The thumbnail's and the frame's shape: circle for a person, square for a thing.

aspect.summary: The preview frame's proportion and the editor's frame, «16/9», «1/1», «1.91/1». Empty: a circle is 1/1, else the picture's own proportion (16/9 until it loads).

fit.summary: cover: the picture fills its box and the focal point stays in it (a photo, a cover); contain: the whole picture is fitted (a logo). Never stretched.

sources.summary: Where a picture may come from, a list separated by commas or spaces: device (the file dialog), library (the page's library: the field sends library and the page calls setValue()), url (an address typed in the field). One source: «Выбрать…» / «Заменить…» goes there; more: «Заменить ▾» opens a menu of them (C94 point 5).

library-label.summary: The library item's words in the menu, «Из письма»; «Из библиотеки» / From the library by default.

edit.summary: What the person may edit on the picture, a list separated by commas or spaces: crop (the frame in `aspect`, with zoom and position), focus (the focal point). «Изменить» opens the editor in the field; «Готово» writes crop {aspect, zoom, x, y} and focus {x, y} into the value. The original is never cut (C94 point 3).

alt.summary: The picture's description inside the field (C94 point 4): field shows «Описание изображения» and «Декоративная»; required also keeps the form from submitting until it is written or the picture is marked decorative. The value carries alt and decorative.

meta.summary: The line under the name; by default the image's dimensions once it loads and its size («450×300 · 2 КБ»).

empty-text.summary: The words of the empty field; «Изображение не выбрано» / No image chosen by default.

required.summary: The field must hold an image: the form will not submit without one, and an empty field says «Выберите изображение.» under itself once focus leaves it or the form is checked. A required field has no remove button (IF-6).

disabled.summary: Shown and not changed: no fill, the disabled line and ink, as sf-input; the buttons are disabled and a drop or paste is refused.

readonly.summary: Shown without buttons, with the line of a region for its edge, as sf-input read-only; a drop or paste is refused.

invalid.summary: The error state: the edge and the message take the error colour and the group carries aria-invalid.

error-message.summary: The error shown in place of the hint while the field is invalid; slot `error` takes markup instead.

uploader.summary: The page's transfer, a property, the contract sf-file-upload's uploader has: async function (file, {signal, onProgress, value}) answering the stored value ({value, href} or an id). With it the field sends each file it takes and shows the transfer on the picture: a ring with the share onProgress(done, total) reports, «Отменить»; on a failure the thrown error's message under the field and «Повторить». While it runs the form will not submit. Without it the host uploads the File the events carry and calls setValue().

value.summary: The image in the file shape {value, label, mime, size, href, file?}, plus what the field knows of the picture: width, height, alt, decorative, focus {x, y} and crop {aspect, zoom, x, y}, each only when there. null when empty; the attribute takes an address or the shape as JSON
The new value in the file shape; a chosen file carries `file` and an object URL in `href` until the host writes the stored value. null after a removal.

file.summary: The File chosen, or null after a removal.

change.summary: The image was chosen, dropped, pasted, taken by address, described, edited or removed: once per change the person made, a CustomEvent on the host carrying the value, the File and the form name (source names which). With an uploader, change (source upload) also follows a finished transfer, the value then carrying the stored id; a cancelled one sends source cancel. The platform input's own change and the inner fields' do not leave the host.

value.summary: The new value in the file shape; a chosen file carries `file` and an object URL in `href` until the host writes the stored value. null after a removal.

file.summary: The File chosen, or null after a removal.

input.summary: Sent with every change the person made, before it, with the same detail, as a native file input sends input and change together; while the description is typed, on each key.

attach.summary: A file was chosen or dropped: the File to upload. The host uploads it and sets the stored value. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-image-field:select follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

detach.summary: The person removed the image; detail carries the value it held. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-image-field:remove follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

rejected.summary: Files the field did not take, each with its reason and the words said under the field: rejected [{file, name, reason, message}], reason type | empty | size | min-width | min-height | unreadable | count (the files beyond the first of a drop). Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-image-field:reject follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

library.summary: The person chose «Из библиотеки» (sources library): the page opens its own library -- Larena «Файлы», the letter's images -- and calls setValue() with the picture.

clear.summary: Empty the field from code; the same as setValue(null). Returns the element.

choose.summary: Open the platform file dialog, as «Выбрать…» and «Заменить…» do with the device source. Returns false when the field is disabled or read-only.

remove-image.summary: Remove the image as the person would with the remove button: input, change and sf-input-image-detach fire, focus goes to «Выбрать…»; a required field then says it is empty. Returns whether there was an image to remove.

take-file.summary: Take a File as the person would by choosing it (source input, drop, paste or another the host names): the checks run (accept, max-size, min-width, min-height), the thumbnail shows it from an object URL and input, change and sf-input-image-attach fire; a refused file is said under the field and in rejected instead. With min-width or min-height the picture is read first, and the answer is a promise of the outcome.

set-error.summary: Show an error message and the invalid state, or clear both with an empty message. Writes error-message and invalid. Returns the element.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §16.20). Event rows send the new name first, then the old one, with one detail; setting rows map the old attribute and property to the new; host-attribute rows (no "to") stay host attributes read by the browser or the base and are listed, refused by the shim on purpose; documentary rows ("shim": "none") record a rename the shim cannot serve.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the base (§3.1, §4.8); no shim
the detail keeps file, source, value and name and adds files: the old fields are all there
rows.summary: A file was chosen or dropped: the File to upload. The host uploads it and sets the stored value. Legacy name: sent after sf-image-field-attach with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).
The person removed the image; detail carries the value it held. Legacy name: sent after sf-image-field-detach with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

Files the accept list does not name were left out, as the platform dialog would not have offered them; announced politely. Legacy name: sent after sf-image-field-rejected with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

rows.note: error is a dated alias of invalid; the attribute and the property write invalid
rows.summary: The error state; the same as invalid.

rows.section: rename plan R0 (ui-control RENAME-PLAN-2026-11-03), naming decision 2026-11-02
rows.note: the element is sf-input-image; sf-image-field is a subclass defined beside it until the date
the event name carries the tag
the event name carries the tag
the event name carries the tag; new in 1.4.0, sent under the dated tag too so a page on sf-image-field hears it
the event name carries the tag

x-summary: A form field for one image: a row (thumbnail, name and size, the buttons) or a preview (the picture in its frame, the row under it); a file chosen, dropped or pasted, or a picture from the page's library or an address; the upload core's checks with the reason under the field; the description and «Декоративная», the frame and the focal point inside the field; label, help, error, required, disabled and read-only as every field has them. It raises the chosen File, or sends it through the page's uploader.
x-renamed: settings.aria-label: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)
events.sf-image-field:select -> attach (vocabulary §5 attach {files}: the File the person chose, which the host uploads)
settings.error -> invalid (§17.2: error is a dated alias of invalid)
x-decisions: alias-conflict: vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1 decides -- sf-image-field:remove is sf-image-field-detach and sf-image-field:reject is sf-image-field-rejected; stand 18's planned sf-image-field-remove and -reject never shipped, so they get no alias
sf-image-field:select is sf-image-field-attach (vocabulary §5 attach {files}); its detail keeps file, source, value and name and adds files
version: 1.1.0 -- three events and the setting error move behind dated aliases, set-error is added; a minor while the aliases hold (§4.10)
key-effects: Enter and Space on «Выбрать…» or «Заменить…» open the platform file dialog; on «Убрать» they remove the image (a button's own press)
template: the default template stays the Lit module js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; template.html follows when the build compiles HTML templates
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and docs.md
css-variables: the ten public variables the field already had (2026-10-24), now declared in the manifest
value: an object, nullable (§4.2): the file shape; the attribute stays as the class adds it -- an address or the shape as JSON

form: the host is the form control through ElementInternals (§17.1): the chosen File, or the stored image's id (else its address); nothing while empty or disabled, and while read-only it still submits; the native file input carries no name
validity: value-missing while required and empty; set-error {message} sets custom-error, so the form does not submit (§17.2)
actions answer outcomes (§4.4): choose, remove-image, take-file and clear are applied or refused (inactive, empty, rejected, unchanged); set-error is applied
host-states: data-dragged-over while a file is held over the field (§5.3)
ids: the part ids come from the instance path (§7.1.1), not a module counter

empty-text: default "" -- a host-written text wins, and without one the template says the language file's runtime.empty itself; a setting that defaulted to the word would differ from what the template reads (the template-context probe)

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.1.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.3: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.
version 1.1.8: the file size is core's (core/js/format.js formatFileSize, SF.format.fileSize, core.runtime 1.20.0; reuse audit 2026-11-02, finding 7), with the field's own unit words. The same text.

version 1.2.0: the tag is sf-input-image (naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>]); the folder, the id smart.input-image and the bundle cl-input-image follow it. sf-image-field stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: a subclass the Smart base defines beside the new tag, listed in the rule, in sheets as :is(sf-input-image, sf-image-field) (change journal tag-sf-image-field-to-sf-input-image, path-smart-image-field-to-input-image).

version 1.2.1: the file size comes from core/js/format-file-size.js, the size helpers alone with no top-level side effect, instead of core/js/format.js, which published SF.format from the bundle and so kept every format helper in it (core.runtime 1.28.0; ui-chart, 2026-11-05). The same text; the bundle is smaller.

version 1.2.2: the provenance digest of core/js/composition/file-size.mjs follows that module, which now also exports the content.file icon table (FILE_ICONS, fileIcon). The component imports only fileNameFromAddress from it; no visible change, the bundle is the same.

version 1.2.3 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its first-paint sheet list names the kbd sheet (component.kbd 1.1.0, docs review R030): sf-button 1.8.0 draws a shortcut's keys with it, and every component that draws an sf-button asks for it before the first paint. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.2.4: the sf-button and sf-button-icon it draws are asked for their current names (appearance ghost for link, status danger for error; actions block, decisions C13 and C15), so the template uses no dated alias; nothing it draws changes.

version 1.2.5 (2026-11-09): a patch, nothing drawn or done differently. The generated reference gives each action's method its one object argument, takeFile({file, source}), setError({message}), where it read the parameters one by one (standard §4.4: the parameters arrive as one object). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.1 (2026-11-09): the field is transparent at rest, so it stands on any place (C16, the background system, owner 2026-11-08); a file held over it keeps the dashed edge, in the primary outline.

version 1.3.2 (2026-11-10, C16 leftovers): a patch; nothing draws or works differently. Its docs gave a stale default: --sf-image-field-background-color is transparent (since 1.3.1), not --sf-surface-0.

version 1.3.3 (2026-11-11): a patch, nothing drawn differently. The sheet reads the C16 roles by their current names where it read the former ones, which are var() of them wherever they are declared (src/core/contracts/token-aliases.v1.json, sf-role-aliases): --sf-disable → --sf-surface-disabled; --sf-on-disable → --sf-on-surface-disabled ×2; --sf-on-surface-container--variant → --sf-on-surface-container-variant; --sf-outline-disable → --sf-outline-disabled; --sf-outline-primary → --sf-primary-outline; --sf-primary-transparent-select → --sf-primary-state-select. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.4.0 (2026-11-12, study R176 IF-1..IF-16, owner C94): two layouts, row and preview (the setting is layout: view is reserved by the element core), shape, aspect, fit; the checks of the upload core (component/file-upload/js/intake.mjs, shared with sf-file-upload) with max-size, and min-width / min-height read from the picture; a refused file and extra dropped files said under the field and in rejected {rejected}; paste; no drag words on a coarse pointer; a required field has no remove button and says it is empty when focus leaves it or the form is checked; remove is an icon button and the size line wraps; read-only and disabled drawn as sf-input; the checkerboard under a picture that may be transparent (C86); alt is the description, never the file name; sources device / library / url with «Заменить ▾»; the description and «Декоративная» inside the field (alt); the frame and the focal point edited in the field (edit), written into the value; uploader: the transfer on the picture, cancel, retry, the form waits for it. The sheet reads the current role names, not the C16 aliases retired on 2027-01-01 (--sf-on-surface-container-variant, --sf-primary-state-select, --sf-primary-outline); the values are the same.

version 1.4.1 (2026-11-13, group build 2 intent acceptance, fields-1): a patch. sources and edit read a list separated by commas, spaces or both: `device library url` and `crop, focus` read as `device,library,url` and `crop,focus` (a space list did nothing in 1.4.0; sf-input-country's preferred already took both). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

$comment: sf-input-image loads on demand like any other Smart element. Its relations
are what it draws with: the buttons «Выбрать…», «Заменить…» and «Изменить»
(sf-button, which brings its own icons), the remove and cancel icons (sf-
button-icon) and the glyph of an empty or broken thumbnail (the icon font);
on demand, when the page turns them on, the upload ring (sf-progress-ring),
the description and the address fields (sf-input), «Декоративная» (sf-
switch) and the menu of sources (sf-menu-context). The file dialog is the

forbidden_client_responsibilities: choosing where the file is stored

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-input-image for a form value that is one image -- a logo, a cover, an avatar, a picture in a block -- shown, replaced and removed in place; layout preview when the look matters, row in dense forms.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not use it for several files or a transfer list: that is sf-file-upload
Do not lay buttons over the picture or crop the original: the frame and focal point go in the value

accessibility.focus: A group named by the field label and described by the help or error text. «Выбрать…», «Заменить…» (or «Заменить ▾» with a menu of sources), «Изменить» and the remove icon are real buttons named for what they act on («Заменить изображение «logo.png»»); the thumbnail's alt is the description the person wrote (empty for a decorative picture or none). The drop target takes no focus, so it is never a stop or a trap; a paste lands while any of its buttons has focus. After a removal focus goes to «Выбрать…». A choice, a removal, a refused file and a transfer's end are announced in a polite status. The editor's stage takes focus: the arrows move the frame or the point, + and − zoom, Enter finishes, Escape cancels.

sf-image-field:select.summary: A file was chosen or dropped: the File to upload. The host uploads it and sets the stored value. Legacy name: sent after sf-image-field-attach with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

sf-image-field:remove.summary: The person removed the image; detail carries the value it held. Legacy name: sent after sf-image-field-detach with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

sf-image-field:reject.summary: Files the accept list does not name were left out, as the platform dialog would not have offered them; announced politely. Legacy name: sent after sf-image-field-rejected with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

setValue.summary: Set the image from code, in the file shape or as an address; null empties the field. Fires nothing, as a value set from code is not a change. Returns the element.

aria-label.description: The group's accessible name when no label is drawn inside the field: a form that prints the label beside it (the Framework's field renderers) names the field without a second, visible label.
